description: Experiment B/C. Stillpoint, Mineral Gravity Organism (Extraordinary Kinship companion lookbook p.14 + isolated concept sheet). Produced from 2D reference only; no pre-existing Stillpoint or donor mesh is used.

sources.provenance: Owner-supplied isolated Stillpoint concept sheet (attached to the 2026-11-18 assignment). AI-generated concept art.
Owner-supplied lookbook. Page 14 is a crop of an embedded 1536x1024 'Anomalous Life' sheet; the native image is extracted losslessly with pdfimages.
Owner-supplied illustration of a reconstruction pipeline. Generated artwork depicting a process, not evidence of any implementation.
sources.role: not used for geometry or texture

persp_a.notes: elevated 3/4 view; blueprint background with dimension lines and callout arrows

persp_b.notes: near-duplicate of persp_a with different details (crystal sizes, apparent fifth leg)

scale_lineup.class: scale lineup (side elevations on a common ground line, with a human figure)

not_segmented.lookbook_main: panel crop cuts through the subject at both side borders and the ground shadow is tonally close to the stone, so a border background model fails; used qualitatively and for feature matching only

measure.crystal_height_note: Crystal height above the dorsal plates: lookbook lineup 0.50 m, lookbook painting ~0.47 m, concept-sheet 3/4 views ~0.8 m (perspective-inflated). 1.4x the lineup value (0.70 m) keeps the main cluster as prominent as both sources show it.
measure.front: image-top of the top view (the broad end); the references do not show a head, so this is a design decision

build.underside_note: General body underside at 0.55 x dorsal height (~1.05 m), keel lower: measured on persp_a / lookbook_main (body bottom ~0.55 of dorsal height above the feet). The 42 px lineup sketch counts the upper legs as body and is not used for this.

fit.note: persp_a and lookbook_main contributed two height ratios (underside, crystal allowance); persp_b, wire_a and wire_b contributed nothing to geometry.
fit.el_note: Elevation bounded to 8-30 deg: the references show the dorsal surface as a thin band, not a 45-deg plan view; unbounded, the optimiser hides proportion errors by raising the camera.

game_ready.reduce_note: Crystals, limb blocks, keel and the leg cores keep full geometry (silhouette-defining). Plate tops lose their subdivision; their relief is baked from the full-resolution source parts into the normal map (selected-to-active).
game_ready.gait_note: Lateral-sequence walk (hind, fore, other hind, other fore) with 78% stance: always three feet down, as the lookbook walk-cycle sketches suggest for a heavy body. Stride limited so the legs never reach full extension (measured by anim_check).
